# EntoBio Consult

Independent scientific research and consulting organisation based in Bengaluru,
Karnataka, India. Founded 2025 by Dr. H. M. Yeshwanth, Ph.D., FRES.

Specialisms: insect taxonomy, species identification, biodiversity surveys,
scientific macro and focus-stacked imaging, museum collection curation,
integrated pest management consultancy, and biodiversity education.

Dr. Yeshwanth has described approximately 150 insect species new to science,
primarily plant bugs (Hemiptera: Miridae) and leafhoppers (Cicadellidae), and
has authored 36 peer-reviewed publications. Three species have been named in
his honour. He is a Fellow of the Royal Entomological Society, London, and a
twice-recipient of the Ernst Mayr Travel Grant from Harvard University's Museum
of Comparative Zoology. He formerly served as Scientist In-charge and Curator
of the Museum and Collection Facility at NCBS-TIFR.

ORCID: 0000-0002-5104-3401
Contact: contact@entobioconsult.com
Location: Bengaluru, Karnataka, India
Consulting: Worldwide
Physical specimen imaging intake: Indian institutions only (universities, museums, ICAR institutes, research labs)

## Dedicated Scientific Imaging Lab (/imaging)
EntoBio Consult operates a specialised optical macro and micro imaging laboratory in Bengaluru, delivering publication-grade focus-stacked imagery, type specimen documentation, and collection digitisation.

Imaging Services:
1. Single Specimen Imaging — Focus-stacked macro and micro plates of individual specimens (insects, arthropods, botanical material).
2. Type Specimen Documentation — Diagnostic imaging of holotypes, paratypes, and voucher material, including dorsal, lateral, and genitalic dissections.
3. Collection Digitisation — Batch imaging of museum drawers, unit trays, teaching sets, and reference collections.
4. Slide & Microscope Preparation Imaging — Transmitted light, brightfield, and phase imaging of slide preparations.
5. Comparative Plates — Multi-specimen plates composed and scaled to journal specifications.
6. Custom Documentation — Imaging workflows tailored to non-standard research questions.

Scope & Specimen Intake:
Specimens accepted strictly from Indian domestic institutions (dry-mounted, slide-mounted, alcohol-preserved). Due to biological permit and transfer complexities, international specimen intake is not available.
